title_or_hook: Ever seen a real-life cyberpunk garage?
post:
Ever seen a real-life cyberpunk garage? 🏍️✨ At Zhang Tie’s custom motorcycle workshop in China, the night shift is pure magic. Just raw, hand-welding sparks flying everywhere! 🔥 

They hosted North American and European tour groups in 2024. After a quick safety briefing, visitors got front-row seats to the grinding and welding action. 📸 

It’s that authentic, gritty maker vibe we all love. Would you grab a camera and film this? 🎥👇
